natural: be generous with rewards, light with punishment

meaning.en: To be generous in rewarding good deeds (and let the reward reach far), while being lenient in punishing wrong.
meaning.zh: 对善行要多加表彰、从宽奖励，使其流传久远；与“恶恶从短”相对，主张惩罚从轻。

equivalents: be generous to merit and lenient to fault

examples.zh: 评价他人要善善从长，不可吹毛求疵。
examples.en: In judging others, accentuate the positive and don't nitpick.

examples.zh: 老师善善从长，总能发现学生的闪光点。
examples.en: The teacher is generous with praise and always finds each student's strengths.

story.en: The Gongyang Commentary says the gentleman's goodwill toward the good is long-reaching, his hatred of evil short (君子之善善也长，恶恶也短).
story.zh: 《公羊传·昭公二十年》：“君子之善善也长，恶恶也短。”

usage.en: Rare, literary; often paired with 恶恶从短. Used as advice on how to judge others.
usage.zh: 较少见，书面语，常与“恶恶从短”并用，多作评价他人的劝诫。

natural: greet people with a kindly air

meaning.en: To meet people with a friendly, warm manner.
meaning.zh: 以和善友好的态度对待别人。

examples.zh: 服务行业要善气迎人，让顾客有宾至如归之感。
examples.en: In service work you should greet people warmly so that customers feel at home.

examples.zh: 他总是善气迎人，邻里关系十分融洽。
examples.en: He is always genial, and relations with the neighbours are very good.

story.en: Guanzi: 'A kindly manner toward others is closer than brothers' (善气迎人，亲于兄弟).
story.zh: 《管子·心术下》：“善气迎人，亲于兄弟；恶气迎人，害于戈兵。”

date.zh: 战国至西汉 · 前4—前1世纪
date.en: Warring States to Western Han, 4th–1st c. BC

usage.en: Praise of courtesy; fits service and social settings. Written style.
usage.zh: 称赞待人和气，多用于服务、交际场合，书面语。

natural: tongue worn out and lips parched

meaning.en: To talk so long and hard that one's tongue and lips are worn out, often in vain.
meaning.zh: 舌头磨破了，嘴唇干焦了，形容反复劝说、说话极多。

equivalents: talk until one is blue in the face

examples.zh: 我舌敝唇焦地劝了他一晚上，他还是不肯去。
examples.en: I talked myself hoarse persuading him all evening, but he still won't go.

examples.zh: 为了争取支持，他舌敝唇焦，四处奔走。
examples.en: To win support he talked himself dry, running around everywhere.

usage.en: Often implies much effort with little result. Predicate or adverbial.
usage.zh: 常含费尽口舌而收效不大之意，作谓语或状语。

natural: sacrifice the chariot to save the general

meaning.en: To sacrifice something of lesser value to protect what matters most (from Chinese chess).
meaning.zh: 放弃次要的以保全最重要的（原为象棋术语）。

equivalents: sacrifice a pawn to save the king

examples.zh: 公司为了活下去，只好舍车保帅，关掉亏损的分部。
examples.en: To survive, the company had to sacrifice a lesser unit and close the loss-making branch.

examples.zh: 危急时刻，他选择舍车保帅，牺牲小利。
examples.en: In the crisis he chose to give up a small gain to protect the main interest.

usage.en: Note the reading 车 jū (chess piece). Often describes a hard choice; can also carry a hint of abandoning a subordinate.
usage.zh: 注意“车”在象棋中读 jū。常指艰难的取舍，有时暗含牺牲下属的意味。

literal: deep · law text · thorough · weave in
natural: twist the law to frame someone

meaning.en: To twist the letter of the law and build an airtight-seeming case to convict an innocent person.
meaning.zh: 援引法律条文苛刻地罗织罪名，陷人于罪。

equivalents: twist the law to frame someone

examples.zh: 酷吏深文周纳，制造了无数冤案。
examples.en: The cruel officials twisted the law and created countless miscarriages of justice.

examples.zh: 他们对一句玩笑话深文周纳，硬说成是罪证。
examples.en: They twisted a casual joke into evidence of guilt.

usage.en: Derogatory; used of legal or political persecution. 纳 here read nà.
usage.zh: 贬义，多指在法律或政治上陷害人。

natural: spirit adrift

meaning.en: To be so entranced, distracted or shaken that one cannot stay composed.
meaning.zh: 精神恍惚，心神不定，也指陶醉入迷。

examples.zh: 听了那段音乐，他神魂飘荡，久久不能平静。
examples.en: After hearing that music he felt adrift and couldn't calm down for a long time.

examples.zh: 考试前一夜，他神魂飘荡，什么也看不进。
examples.en: The night before the exam he was in a daze and couldn't take in anything.

usage.en: Literary; can mean infatuated or merely unsettled depending on context. Similar to 神魂颠倒.
usage.zh: 书面语，依语境可指陶醉或心神不定，近“神魂颠倒”。

natural: fame that shakes the world

meaning.en: Reputation that resounds across the whole world.
meaning.zh: 名声震动天下。

examples.zh: 这位科学家的成就声振寰宇。
examples.en: This scientist's achievements are known around the world.

examples.zh: 她的演出声振寰宇，座无虚席。
examples.en: Her performances resound worldwide and play to full houses.

usage.en: Formal praise; fits tributes and speeches. Also seen as 声震寰宇.
usage.zh: 正式的褒扬语，用于颂词、讲话，也作“声震寰宇”。

natural: a splendid feast cannot be repeated

meaning.en: A magnificent gathering is hard to repeat; cherish good times while they last.
meaning.zh: 盛大的宴会难以再有，比喻美好的时光和聚会不易重现。

equivalents: a grand occasion won't come again

examples.zh: 盛筵难再，大家今晚尽兴吧。
examples.en: A feast like this won't come twice, so let's enjoy tonight to the full.

examples.zh: 毕业聚会上，同学们感叹盛筵难再。
examples.en: At the graduation party the classmates sighed that such times won't return.

story.en: Wang Bo's 'Preface to Tengwang Pavilion': 'Famous places do not last forever; a splendid feast is hard to repeat' (胜地不常，盛筵难再).
story.zh: 王勃《滕王阁序》：“胜地不常，盛筵难再。”

usage.en: Often used with sentiment at a farewell party.
usage.zh: 常用于告别聚会时的感叹。

natural: bad times and a hard fate

meaning.en: To be born at a bad time with an unlucky destiny.
meaning.zh: 时运不好，命运坎坷。

examples.zh: 他自叹时乖命蹇，屡试不第。
examples.en: He lamented his ill luck and failed the exams again and again.

examples.zh: 哪有什么时乖命蹇，只是努力不够。
examples.en: There's no such thing as bad fate, only not enough effort.

usage.en: Literary self-pity; 蹇 reads jiǎn (lame). Also written 时乖运蹇.
usage.zh: 书面语，多用于自叹。“蹇”读 jiǎn。

natural: treat as worthless as weeds

meaning.en: To regard something or someone as completely worthless.
meaning.zh: 把人或事物看得像小草一样轻贱。

examples.zh: 这家企业把员工视如草芥，难怪人才流失。
examples.en: This firm treats its staff like dirt, so no wonder talent leaves.

examples.zh: 他对金钱视如草芥，一生清贫。
examples.en: He regarded money as worthless and lived poor all his life.

usage.en: Can criticise contempt for people, or (rarely) praise indifference to wealth.
usage.zh: 多批评对人的轻视，偶尔也形容对钱财淡泊。

natural: cannot bite one's own navel

meaning.en: To regret too late; trying to bite one's own navel is impossible.
meaning.zh: 自己咬自己的肚脐够不着，比喻后悔已来不及。

equivalents: rue it when it's too late

examples.zh: 现在不努力，将来只会噬脐莫及。
examples.en: If you don't work hard now, you'll only regret it too late.

examples.zh: 错过了这次机会，他噬脐莫及。
examples.en: He missed the chance, and regret came too late.

story.en: Zuo Zhuan: 'If you do not act early, you will bite the navel (噬齐) and be unable to reach it' — a warning to the ruler of Deng.
story.zh: 《左传·庄公六年》：“若不早图，后君噬齐，其及图之乎？”

usage.en: Literary; stronger than 后悔莫及. 噬 is read shì.
usage.zh: 书面语，语气比“后悔莫及”重。

natural: ease the muscles and boost circulation

meaning.en: To relax the muscles and tendons and improve blood circulation (a TCM term).
meaning.zh: 放松筋骨，促进血液循环（中医用语）。

equivalents: loosen the muscles and improve circulation

examples.zh: 热水泡脚能舒筋活血。
examples.en: Soaking your feet in hot water eases the muscles and improves circulation.

examples.zh: 这款药油有舒筋活血的功效。
examples.en: This medicated oil helps relax the sinews and boost circulation.

usage.en: Commonly used in health and TCM advertising; 血 reads xuè in this word.
usage.zh: 常见于保健、中医用语，此处“血”读 xuè。

natural: careless oversight

meaning.en: Carelessness that causes one to overlook something important.
meaning.zh: 粗心大意，对该注意的事没有注意。

examples.zh: 一时疏忽大意，他把文件落在了出租车上。
examples.en: In a moment of carelessness he left the file in the taxi.

examples.zh: 安全检查时不能疏忽大意。
examples.en: You must not be careless during the safety check.

usage.en: Common in warnings; usually followed by consequences. Often 一时疏忽大意.
usage.zh: 常用于告诫，后面多接后果。

natural: well-balanced spacing

meaning.en: Spaced with pleasing variation between sparse and dense, harmonious and well arranged.
meaning.zh: 疏朗和紧密安排得错落有致。

examples.zh: 这幅画的构图疏密有致。
examples.en: This painting's composition has a pleasing balance of sparse and dense.

examples.zh: 园子里的花木疏密有致，十分耐看。
examples.en: The plants in the garden are arranged with well-judged spacing and are lovely to look at.

usage.en: Used for painting, calligraphy, gardens and layout. Positive.
usage.zh: 用于绘画、书法、园林、版面，含褒义。

natural: petty thief

meaning.en: Sneaky petty theft, or a petty thief.
meaning.zh: 像老鼠、狗一样偷偷摸摸地偷东西，也指小偷小摸的人。

examples.zh: 这一带治安不好，常有鼠窃狗偷之辈出没。
examples.en: Security is poor here and petty thieves are about.

examples.zh: 他从不干鼠窃狗偷的勾当。
examples.en: He never gets into petty theft.

usage.en: Derogatory. Also written 鼠窃狗盗 (鼠窃狗盗 is the more common form).
usage.zh: 贬义。

natural: the coldest days of winter

meaning.en: The coldest period of winter, the 'nine nines' that begin at the winter solstice.
meaning.zh: 冬至起算的“九九”寒冷时节，指一年中最冷的日子。

examples.zh: 数九寒天，他还坚持每天晨跑。
examples.en: Even in the dead of winter he keeps up his daily morning run.

examples.zh: 数九寒天里，一碗热汤格外暖心。
examples.en: In the depths of winter, a bowl of hot soup is especially warming.

usage.en: Describes weather; 数 reads shǔ (count). Usually the setting of a sentence.
usage.zh: 描写天气，“数”读 shǔ（计数），多作时间状语。

natural: count the rice grains before cooking

meaning.en: To count rice grain by grain before cooking: to be petty and stingy; also, to be absurdly fussy over trifles.
meaning.zh: 一粒一粒地数着米下锅，形容吝啬，也比喻做事琐碎，不顾大局。

examples.zh: 他过日子数米而炊，一分钱也舍不得多花。
examples.en: He lives so penny-pinching that he won't spend an extra cent.

examples.zh: 管理不能数米而炊，要抓大放小。
examples.en: Management can't be about counting every grain; focus on what's big.

story.en: Zhuangzi says of petty cleverness: 'combing out single hairs, counting rice to cook' (简发而栉，数米而炊), which is fussy and gets nothing big done.
story.zh: 《庄子·庚桑楚》：“简发而栉，数米而炊，窃窃乎又何足以济世哉！”

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

usage.en: Derogatory in modern use; 数 reads shǔ. It criticises pettiness; it is not praise for thrift.
usage.zh: 现代多含贬义，“数”读 shǔ，指过分琐碎吝啬，并非褒扬节俭。

natural: keep oneself pure

meaning.en: To restrain oneself and keep one's conduct clean and upright.
meaning.zh: 约束自己，保持品行端正，不同流合污。

equivalents: keep to the straight and narrow

examples.zh: 在复杂的环境里，他始终束身自好。
examples.en: In a complicated environment he always kept himself clean.

examples.zh: 束身自好的人，不会收这种礼。
examples.en: A person of integrity wouldn't accept a gift like this.

usage.en: Praise of integrity; sometimes implies keeping aloof. Often paired with 洁身自好.
usage.zh: 褒义，有时带有不与人合流之意，近“洁身自好”。

natural: excuse me, I won't be joining

meaning.en: A polite or curt way to decline to accompany someone or take part.
meaning.zh: 客气地表示不能陪同，有时带有生硬拒绝之意。

equivalents: I'm afraid I can't join you

examples.zh: 我还有会要开，恕不奉陪。
examples.en: I have a meeting to attend; please excuse me.

examples.zh: 你要是不讲理，我就恕不奉陪了。
examples.en: If you won't be reasonable, count me out.

usage.en: Polite in form, but can be cold or sarcastic when you are annoyed. 恕 reads shù.
usage.zh: 形式客气，生气时也可带讥讽或冷淡。“恕”读 shù。

natural: forgive me, I cannot comply

meaning.en: A courteous way of refusing a request.
meaning.zh: 客气地拒绝别人的要求。

examples.zh: 这个要求有违原则，恕难从命。
examples.en: This request goes against principle, so I'm afraid I must decline.

examples.zh: 您的好意我心领了，只是恕难从命。
examples.en: I appreciate your kindness but must decline.

usage.en: Formal, polite refusal; fits business and letters.
usage.zh: 正式、客气的拒绝，用于商务、书信。

natural: withered grass reaching the sky

meaning.en: Withered grass stretching to the horizon, a bleak autumn landscape.
meaning.zh: 枯草一直连到天边，形容秋冬荒凉萧瑟的景象。

examples.zh: 深秋的原野上衰草连天，一派荒凉。
examples.en: On the late-autumn plain, withered grass stretched to the horizon, bleak and empty.

examples.zh: 衰草连天的古道上，只有他一人独行。
examples.en: On the old road lined with withered grass, he walked alone.

usage.en: Scenic, melancholy; used in prose and poetry. 衰 reads shuāi here.
usage.zh: 描写景色，带萧瑟感，用于散文和诗词。“衰”读 shuāi。

natural: no fish in perfectly clear water

meaning.en: Water too clear has no fish: if you demand perfection, you'll have no companions.
meaning.zh: 水太清了，鱼就待不住，比喻对人要求过于苛刻就没人愿意相处。

examples.zh: 带团队要懂得水清无鱼的道理，别太苛求。
examples.en: In leading a team, remember that water too clear has no fish; don't be too exacting.

examples.zh: 水清无鱼，对孩子不能事事求全。
examples.en: With children, don't demand perfection in everything.

story.en: Dongfang Shuo's advice: 'When water is too clear there are no fish; when a man is too exacting he has no followers' (水至清则无鱼，人至察则无徒).
story.zh: 《汉书·东方朔传》：“水至清则无鱼，人至察则无徒。”

usage.en: Advice to be tolerant; usually used in the full form 水至清则无鱼，人至察则无徒. Can also excuse laxity.
usage.zh: 劝人宽容的话，常用全句“水至清则无鱼，人至察则无徒”，也可能被用来为放任找借口。
